The approved raw 100 is unchanged and is the byte anchor (raw 92cdc2f9..., read from canonical encyclopedia main 9b26aa28fc7e16f6652aaec292b4edf84e20db71, path refinement/decklists/Lord_Xander_the_Collector_Approved_2026-10-14.txt, blob 025aa284, introduced by canonical commit 214fd50 on 2026-10-14; registry source_commit 1836b97 holds the same bytes; overrides APPROVED/LOCKED 2026-10-14). RETAIN_CANONICAL_AUTHORITY. Registry canonical project export: the same 100 in a different text format and order. Logical hash = registry baseline (lh1:84233c91...). Current, not stale.

LOCAL_BEST_IN_TESTED_POOL_RESEARCH_ONLY (three genuine swaps, below the five-swap floor; NOT owner-presentable; J bundle blocked by the existing Stage A seal mismatch): +Necromancy -Persist (FLAGGED override of an explicit owner keep: Persist targets only a nonlegendary creature card, so it can never return Lord Xander, the Collector; grid B1 Necromancy returns 12/36 versus Persist 4/36, 10 Necromancy-only, 2 Persist-only at exactly two mana; end-step Necromancy gives an extra dies trigger in 1 cell); +Swiftfoot Boots -Lightning Greaves (Greaves' shroud blocks the deck's own targeting: equips, Saw in Half, Molten Duplication, Feign Death, Malakir Rebirth; grid B2 Boots action OK 44/44 versus Greaves 30/44; cost: haste on the same turn only 22/44 cells with equip {1}; goldfish P(Xander attack trigger) turn 7 0.2978 -> 0.2897); +Malakir Rebirth // Malakir Mire -Bojuka Bog (weakest swap; grid B3 ties 6/16 each, 4 Malakir-only, 4 Bog-only; graveyard hate lost). Goldfish P(Xander cast) turn 7 0.3779 unchanged. Spellbook 11 -> 11 included combos; Game Changers 20 -> 20; lands 33 -> 33; Bracket 4 unchanged.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (staged; complete 100 keeping every owner keep and owner add, including Persist). +Necromancy -Karlach, Fury of Avernus plus the Boots and Malakir swaps. Goldfish equals the candidate (turn 7 0.3779 / 0.2897). Karlach is not an explicit owner keep; the cost is the extra-combat secondary close.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (staged; complete 100 keeping every owner keep and owner add). +Necromancy -An Offer You Can't Refuse plus the Boots and Malakir swaps. Goldfish equals the candidate. Costs one cheap counter (12 counters/free interaction remain).

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (Pass C requested comparison; not counted). Goryo's Vengeance returns only legendary creatures (8/36 cells, 4 where Necromancy does not; attack trigger the same turn in 2 cells) but exiles at end step, so no dies trigger and no lasting body; Necromancy returns 12/36. Goldfish equals baseline (the deployment model does not model recursion).

REJECT (Pass C secondary item). Seize the Day gives one extra attack trigger for {3}{R} (flashback {2}{R}); Karlach already untaps attackers and adds a combat every turn it attacks. Goldfish equals the candidate.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (staged; not counted). Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker copies nonlegendary creatures for hasty token ETB/attack value, but costs RRR and adds three commander-independent infinite combos (Spellbook 618-1692 with Helm of the Host, 618-3908 with Spark Double, 618-5361 with Auton Soldier; 11 -> 14 included), against the owner's stated guard on generic infinites. Owner choice.

REJECT. Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore is a clone MDFC land, but the owner rejected further clones as redundant after the selected clone package (Phyrexian Metamorph, Irenicus's Vile Duplication, 2026-10-14), so it is that class; replacing Training Center (untapped U/R in multiplayer) with a tapped mono-U land also costs deployment (goldfish turn 7 cast 0.3749 versus 0.3779).
REJECT. Chrome Mox gains only +0.29 points of P(Xander cast) by turn 7 (0.3808 versus 0.3779, Monte Carlo noise level), costs a card, is generic acceleration and is a Game Changer (20 -> 21).

REJECT. Command Beacon is a colourless utility land replacing Xander's Lounge (a tapped U/B/R triome with cycling): goldfish turn 7 cast 0.3786 versus 0.3779 (untapped, inside noise), but three-colour access and cycling are lost, and commander-tax relief is marginal for a 7-drop that is rarely recast.
